nom: Hero Cosmetics Mighty Patch Mini Invisible+

avis.texte: There are a lot of pimple patches on the market, and these are definitely on the pricier end, but I still think Mighty Patch Invisible are the best ones I’ve tried. They are about as “invisible” as I think a patch can realistically be right now. I don’t usually wear patches like this out of the house during the work week, especially if I’m going into the office, but I do feel comfortable enough wearing these for something like a Saturday morning errand run. Okay, I’m a little vain, so that says something. They stick well, are easy to use, and blend better than most other patches I’ve tried. These have become a constant reorder for me, even with the higher price.

Works as intended. Great for removing whiteheads. Usually would use before going to bed and take them off in the morning. If the whitehead was not completely on the surface when I apply it sometimes I’d need another after. These are just a bit expensive for me and found out the simple field pimple patches work just as good and are cheaper.

These acne patches work exactly as advertised. They’re thin, nearly invisible, and stay in place throughout the day, even under makeup. They help protect blemishes from being touched and noticeably reduce redness and swelling. The patches are comfortable to wear, easy to apply, and peel off without irritating the skin. A great addition to any skincare routine, especially for daytime use. Highly recommend!

avis.titre: It WORKS! Don't hesitate to buy...
avis.texte: These patches are truly invisible. My husband wore one on the tip of his nose overnight and then to work the next day and NEVER even noticed it. These patches work effectively and I highly recommend them. I share with others and am on my second box.

The Hero Invisible Pimple Patches really work! They’re easy to apply, stay on overnight, and are discreet enough to wear during the day if needed. I noticed my blemish looked smaller and less irritated by the next morning, and the patch helped keep me from picking at it. A simple, effective skincare staple that I’ll definitely keep on hand.

PERFECT for a blemish or even a mosquito or spider bite! Love the fact that I can wear one of these patches and you can’t even tell it is there. They work. I don’t need very often, but have found them extremely helpful when you need them. I highly recommend.
Excelentes para los adolescentes que no quieren traer estrellas en la cara
Los mejores pimple patches , soy una persona que sufre acné enterrado y verdaderamente son lo mejor

These have always worked well for me. Love that you can see the gunk before taking it off. I recently used these for a 1 damn pimple on my cheek. It looked pretty big and dangerous so I did not want to pick it. After washing in the morning and evening, I immediately put one of these on the pimple for 2-3 days (day and night). As much as I was tempted to pop the pimple, I’m glad I didn’t. This evening I took off the patch from this morning and I was so excited to see the gunk it removed. Oddly satisfying!

avis.titre: Discretos, cómodos y con buena presentación
avis.texte: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Recibí el producto en muy buen estado y llegó en 4 días desde que lo pedí. Recién estoy empezando a usar estos parches, pero mi primera impresión es positiva. Me gusta que son bastante discretos. De cerca sí se nota que llevas un parche, pero a una distancia normal prácticamente no se ve, por lo que se puede usar durante el día sin problema. Además, vienen muchas unidades en la caja, lo que parece ofrecer una buena duración. Por ahora estoy satisfecho con la compra y seguiré probándolos para evaluar sus resultados a largo plazo.

avis.titre: I wish mighty patch was available 20 years ago..
avis.texte: I only took a picture to prove this is an honest review, even though I got mine through Allure Beauty Box twice. Not a 72 count, but enough to know from the very first time that I used it I could wear it on my chest or face during the day and nobody would even know wherever you have a pimple that would hide and cover and make go away almost overnight.. This is a gold star pimple remover that makes it invisible to the naked eye while it’s working. I will definitely be purchasing it again from Amazon and I can’t say enough about it. It’s a game changer and I’m a lot older than I was, but if I was a teenager or had teenage kids anymore, I would definitely have this as a staple in the house.

avis.titre: Works very well, high-quality well-made product, blends into skin easily to not be noticeable
avis.texte: These are incredible little patches that go on your skin to help fight blemishes. You leave them on for 6-8 hours and they do the work. This is an “invisible” version that blends in easily on the skin. They are easy to use, well-made and effective. I have also used these on my back and they work very well. This is a large 72-count pack which should last a while. I really wish they had these back when I was in high school! A lot easier to use these than messy creams you have to leave on overnight and such. They also do a really good job of blending in with the skin so they are not that noticeable at all!

I’ve tried so many different pimple patches, but these are definitely the best I’ve ever tried. These patches are easy to peel off and adhere to your skin with ease. When a blemish pops up, I know this mighty patch will work its wonder and lift the gunk right out. It’s satisfying to see after 6-8 hours the whitehead form into the patch so you can just peel it right off. I sometimes forget I’m even wearing them, because they tend to become invisible once applied. I personally only wear them at home, but I wouldn’t have any issues wearing them in public as well. The overall quality and effectiveness is the real reason I keep going back to this brand!

avis.titre: Mighty Patch™ Invisible+ Patch – The Barely-There Daytime Hydrocolloid Acne Pimple Patch
avis.texte: These patches are the absolute BEST for hiding pimples. They stay on well and are super thin and nearly invisible. It's important to keep the blemish covered so it can heal and isn't being touched or getting bacteria and makeup on it. The patches are individually sealed in sets of twelve.

I’ve had products like this before, but just brought the blue packaged one and they are not sticky whatsoever. They’re falling off my face just after an hour so disappointed I am definitely not buying this product again. I will go back to what I was using before this one just said extra strength so I thought it’ll do a better job but it’s not sticky whatsoever. Also does not suck the contents out of pimples or pores like the original patch.
I bought a 72 counts one but only received 12 counts one…. Not sure what to do
Do not buy. I opened my “new” package that arrived today and every single patch was used as well as some sort of stains. This is so unhygienic and disgusting. Don’t waste your money.
Per the title, it arrived open and one of the sheets was out of the protective film.
